name: Sengoku Ayame
source:
[url=/c59700]Ichiru's[/url] younger brother, and the eldest son of the Sengoku family. Though a handler at St. Aile's, in charge of [url=/c62419]Sylvia[/url] and [url=/c62420]Velvet[/url], he's also a complete recluse; he hardly shows his face in public.

Even more outspoken than his sister, he usually comes across as haughty or just plain rude.

"And who the hell are you, anyway? Tell me your name, and you can be damn sure I won't forget it. How about that?"

[From [url=http://grisaia-pt.com/en/index.html]official site[/url]]
